# 1. Illustrate the inference with synthetic data

The idea of the inference is quite simple.
We observe a given distribution of values, representing fish sizes.
We assume that the underlying distribution is a normal distribution.
This choice can be seen as a choice toward simplicity.
We say that we only know about the mean and the variance of the distribution, and in this case the most probable distribution is a normal distribution.
